##### Project general facts

Laya Heights is a beautifully considered residential building that sets a fresh standard of elegance, welcoming residents through a striking double-height designer lobby finished in marble and warm timber. The development is home to a generous collection of gracious studio and one bedroom residences, each thoughtfully laid out to feel calm, bright and effortlessly liveable. Every home has been planned with real flexibility in mind, offering comfortable space to work from home as well as to relax, so the building genuinely feels like a self-sufficient private club.

The heart of Laya Heights is its wonderfully complete amenities hub, centred on a resort-style pool with a sun-lounger deck, shaded cabanas, a separate kids pool and a lively outdoor cinema screen. Active residents are superbly looked after with a padel tennis court, a jogging track and a state-of-the-art fitness centre spanning both indoor and outdoor decks with its own dedicated yoga and movement area, plus a soothing sauna for afterwards. There is also a barbecue and picnic area for gatherings, landscaped lawns and a colourful outdoor play area for children, creating a warm sense of community where neighbours can easily connect.

Inside, the residences are dressed in a thoughtful palette of designer oak flooring, custom oak high pressure laminate cabinetry and elegant marble and stone feature walls that lend each home a refined, tactile warmth. The sleek modern kitchens are a real highlight, combining white quartz countertops and matching backsplashes with a suite of high-end Midea appliances fully integrated into the cabinetry and beautifully concealed cove lighting. The bathrooms are equally impressive, with custom oak vanities, backlit mirrors, inbuilt shower niches and designer Jaguar fittings in a chrome finish, while custom oak wardrobes and a smart door lock in every apartment complete the package.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Studio City is not only a place of work and residence but also a center for entertainment and leisure. The community features a range of retail outlets, restaurants, and cafes, providing residents with a variety of dining and shopping options. Additionally, there are recreational facilities, parks, and open spaces where residents can relax, exercise, and enjoy quality time with family and friends.

The community's strategic location offers excellent connectivity to other parts of Dubai, with easy access to major highways and public transportation networks. This ensures that residents can explore the city's attractions, business districts, and cultural landmarks with ease.

Dubai Studio City fosters a sense of community and camaraderie among its residents. The community organizes events, workshops, and networking opportunities that encourage collaboration, learning, and social interaction. These gatherings create a supportive environment for individuals to connect, share ideas, and build professional relationships.
